h:
使用通量放大器 ControlNet 的工作流程。

专门设计用于jasperai / Flux.1-dev-Controlnet-Upscaler

简单

仅包含 Comfy Core 节点 - 需要输入图像、高档尺寸、提示和常用的 Flux 设置。

综合体

具有更多可能（或可能不会）获得更好结果的功能。

输入图像可以选择放大到目标分辨率（本地或通过放大模型），然后编码到输入潜在图像中。更改降噪值将改变 Flux 使用原始图像与 ControlNet 的程度。 （1.0 的降噪将忽略前 Flux 的高档，就像简单工作流程一样，0.0 的降噪将忽略 ControlNet）。这个可能使图像与原始图像更加一致，Flux 只是平滑伪影并填充细节。

有一个可选的否定提示，在某些情况下可能很有用。

WD14 Tagger 节点可用于为肯定提示生成标签。

o.en:
Workflows for using a Flux Upscaler ControlNet.

Specifically designed forjasperai / Flux.1-dev-Controlnet-Upscaler

Simple

Contains only Comfy Core nodes—requires an input image, upscale size, a prompt and the usual Flux settings.

Complex

Has some more features that may (or may not) achieve a better result.

Input image can optionally be scaled up to the target resolution (natively or via an Upscaling Model) which is then encoded into the input latent. Changing the denoise value will then vary how much Flux uses the original image vs the ControlNet. (denoise of 1.0 will ignore the pre-Flux upscale just like the Simple workflow, denoise of 0.0 will ignore the ControlNet). Thismayresult in an image more consistent to the original, with Flux just smoothing out artifacts and filling in details.

There is an optional Negative prompt, which might be useful in some situations.

The WD14 Tagger node can be employed to generate tags for the positive prompt.
